title: Principal Architect - Data & AI Delivery at IT Services Provider Believes Snowflake’s AI Products Will Drive Growth Despite Databricks Gaining Share Faster
expert: Go-to-market lead for Snowflake/Databricks/AWS partnerships at a large IT services provider
verdict: The provider's Snowflake implementation business grew only at a single-digit rate in Aug–Oct as projects shrank from a year or more to 3–6 months [[3 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse20366&hl=fse20366,fse21079,fse23417,fse23825&page=2), even though new deal sizes rose ~10% [[5 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse21524&hl=fse21524,fse21878,fse22237&page=2).

Demand / orders: 🔴 implementation business single-digit growth (Aug–Oct), below plan, vs +15%–16% and +8%–9% on the 2026-11-05 calls: slower. → Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration) ↓ [[3 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse20366&hl=fse20366,fse21079,fse23417,fse23825&page=2)

🟡 projects now 3–6 months vs one year or more, faster than mgmt's ~6-month migrations (SB #59861). [[4 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse22455&hl=fse22455,fse22674,fse22725,fse22784&page=2)

🔴 Cortex agent token costs exceeded budgets, keeping customers at MVP; first read. → Tenet 2 (AI second engine) ↓ [[11 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse11311&hl=fse11311,fse11980,fse12087,fse12163,fse12834,fse13365&page=2)
Pricing & margins: 🟢 new deal sizes +high single digit, closer to 10% on higher platform costs and bill rates, vs $1–1.5 million → $2–2.5 million on the 2026-11-05 integrator call: smaller step-up. [[5 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse21524&hl=fse21524,fse21878,fse22237&page=2)

🟢 program mix 60/40 → 40/60 toward platform consumption (estimate); first read. → Tenet 2 (AI second engine) ↑ [[8 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse31322&hl=fse31322,fse31443&page=2)
Competition & share: 🔴 Databricks gaining share faster; Snowflake share takes "a little bit of a dip" and lost a media company's AI-agent project, vs ~50/50 win rate on the 2026-11-05 SI call: more negative. → Tenet 3 (control point) ↓ [[6 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269109&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse34090&hl=fse34090,fse34090,fse34229,fse34502,fse34596,fse34688,fse34688&page=2)

changes: Implementation business single-digit growth vs +15%–16% (2026-11-05, global integrator) and +8%–9% (2026-11-05, hybrid-cloud SI): slower.
Project length 3–6 months vs mgmt's ~6-month migrations with Cortex Code (SB #59861): shorter, same direction.
Databricks gaining share faster vs ~50/50 head-to-head (2026-11-05, SI managing partner): more negative.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration): ↓ — implementation business single-digit growth, below expectations.
Tenet 2 (AI second engine): → — mix shifting 60/40 → 40/60 toward platform, but Cortex token costs exceed budgets at scale.
Tenet 3 (governed-data control point): ↓ — Databricks gaining share faster; two-platform strategies spreading.
